note: What the game's runtime audio asks of the sound library. `events` are the events of tools/audio/sounds.json that the game has a trigger for, each with the moment it plays. `tools/audio/ship.py` ships, for every event, the library sounds that are that event or stand for it (`generated.standsFor` in the render manifest) and that the owner has approved; an event with none stays silent in the game. `standIn` names events without an approved sound of their own that play the approved sounds of another event: these are choices of the session that built the runtime audio (2026-11-18), not ratings of the owner, and he is told each one. `adopt` gives downloaded sounds a role in the game that the sound list has no event for; he rated the files, not that use. `never` is never shipped, whatever the manifest or the ratings say.

events.engine_main_t000: main engines idle: in flight with no thrust asked for, in cruise, standing on the ground
events.engine_main_t025: main engines, crossfaded by the thrust the pilot asks for
events.engine_main_t050: main engines, crossfaded by the thrust the pilot asks for
events.engine_main_t075: main engines, crossfaded by the thrust the pilot asks for
events.engine_main_boost: main engines while the boost runs
events.thruster_pulse_c: a manoeuvring thruster fires once: the moment sideways or vertical thrust sets in
events.thruster_burn_loop: sideways or vertical thrust is held
events.impact_hull_light: a light hit on the own hull, from the side it came from
events.impact_hull_medium: a solid hit on the own hull
events.impact_hull_heavy: a dangerous hit on the own hull
events.impact_shield_light: a light hit on the own shield, from the side it came from
events.impact_shield_medium: a solid hit on the own shield
events.impact_shield_heavy: a hit that nearly breaks the own shield
events.hull_stress_groan: after a dangerous hull hit or a hard touchdown
events.debris_patter: fragments of a ship destroyed nearby reach the hull
events.gear_deploy: the landing gear extends on the approach to the ground
events.gear_retract: the landing gear retracts after lift-off
events.touchdown_soft: the ship sets down within the limits
events.touchdown_hard: the ship sets down too fast
events.ground_scrape_loop: the ship slides over the ground
events.dust_patter_loop: close above the ground the engines throw up regolith
events.settle_creak: a moment after the ship has come to rest on the ground
events.alarm_heat: heat above nine tenths of the capacity
events.alarm_missile: a missile is closing on the ship
events.alarm_fuel_low: fuel below a tenth of the tank
events.alarm_hull_critical: the hull falls below a quarter
events.cabin_ambience_loop: the cabin, whenever the pilot sits in the ship
events.cabin_ir: the cabin's impulse response: the room every sound is put into
events.mining_laser_loop: the own mining laser or salvage beam works
events.missile_launch: an own missile leaves the rack
events.sensor_contact_ping: a new contact appears on the sensors
events.sensor_proximity_tick: the approach signal close above the ground, faster as the height falls
events.radio_static_loop: an open channel with nobody on it
events.radio_tone: a message arrives on the radio
